caller_tactics.text: Hello, Eszter? This is Gavin Marsh from Sterling Oak Wealth Partners. I'm calling about your pension.
Most people are, until they see what they're missing. We manage a small group of private pension transfers. Your pension could be working much harder.
Simply move your pension into our special fund. Our experts have a view on the market that the big banks just don't have.
Our senior analysts say Brightmoor Lithium, ticker B M L I, is about to take off. The shares have risen forty-five percent since January, and insiders are buying.
It is. And our fund is guaranteed to grow by at least twelve percent a year, so your pension is safe with us.
Not with our approach. We only take a few clients each quarter, so places in the fund are strictly limited.
Only four, and most of our clients took the whole allocation within a week. Please sign the transfer form today.
You don't need to read all that. Our paperwork is just legal boilerplate, and I'll walk you through everything on the call.
I'd leave the adviser out of this for now. They rarely understand a special opportunity like this one.
Eszter, the four places won't last. Shall I send the transfer form to your email?
